verdict.rationale: LightSprint has no documented region or residency selector for its hosted service. However, it says you can run it in your own infrastructure or private cloud (docs-30), which indirectly controls where data lives, likely as a higher-tier deployment option. missing for 10: an explicit region/residency choice for the hosted SaaS, documentation of which data regions are available, details on where tasks, previews and recordings are stored, and independent corroboration of self-hosted deployment.
